name: bdk
description: Sift AI claims, ideas, and products through the Baloney Funnel (Chaos, Confusion, Crapola, Considered) down to what has earned the next investment.

interface.shortDescription: Sift AI claims down to what has earned investment.
interface.longDescription: Run AI claims, roadmaps, and vendor pitches through the Baloney Funnel: Chaos (receipts, sell-by), Confusion (labels, context), Crapola (taste test), and Considered (valuable, usable, viable, feasible), ending in pursue, pivot, or punt. Guided Discovery, Context Dump, and Spitballing modes; five voices.
defaultPrompt: Run this AI roadmap through the Baloney Funnel.
Check the receipts on this vendor claim.
Is this AI pitch value or theater?
